prompts.title: Man in Grey Plaid Suit Reflection
prompts.prompt:
A confident, sophisticated man standing center frame in a luxury editorial portrait.

SUBJECT & POSE
Three-quarter framing, cropped just below the knee. Relaxed yet powerful
luxury-fashion stance: body angled slightly away from camera, face turned
naturally toward the lens. One hand rests casually in the trouser pocket,
the other arm hangs relaxed at his side. Shoulders loose, spine tall,
quiet masculine elegance.

OUTFIT
Bespoke charcoal-grey checked wool suit — sharp-lapel plaid blazer with
matching trousers, impeccably fitted. Beneath it, a black shirt with the
top button open. Visible fabric weave, natural drape and soft creases,
clean stitching, premium material texture. Minimal, expensive, executive.

BACKGROUND
Dark luxury studio with large reflective glass and mirror panels behind
the subject. His reflection appears on both the left and right panels,
creating a distinctive triple-figure effect. Reflections are slightly
darker and softer than the subject but clearly legible and physically
accurate. Deep black to dark charcoal walls with subtle warm brown
undertones, vertical architectural lines, elegant mirror divisions.
Minimal, cinematic, no clutter.

LIGHTING
Cinematic low-key studio lighting. Warm amber rim light from both sides
separating the subject from the background; soft neutral key light on the
face. Controlled shadows, restrained highlights across the suit, natural
skin illumination, warm reflected glow across the mirror surfaces. Moody
luxury atmosphere.

CAMERA & COMPOSITION
Vertical editorial composition, subject centered, eye-level perspective,
medium-long lens compression. Symmetrical studio framing with generous
negative space above the head. Sharp focus on the subject, gentle falloff
behind.

IMAGE QUALITY
Ultra-photorealistic high-end fashion campaign photography. Extremely
detailed face, visible skin pores and natural texture, individual hair
strands, realistic facial hair if present, detailed suit fabric, physically accurate
reflections and shadows, cinematic depth, subtle film grain, HDR, refined
color grading. Medium-format DSLR look, 8K-level detail.

IDENTITY (critical)
Preserve the subject's identity exactly as in the reference photo. Do not
alter facial proportions, bone structure or features. No beautification or
skin smoothing — keep natural imperfections. Preserve the original
hairstyle and facial hair(If present) with real strand separation, true texture and
honest volume.

NEGATIVE PROMPT
cartoon, anime, illustration, CGI, 3D render, plastic skin, distorted
face, altered identity, extra fingers, missing fingers, deformed hands,
bad anatomy, duplicate subject, incorrect reflections, floating body,
unnatural pose, blurry face, low resolution, oversaturated color,
excessive skin smoothing, artificial hair, distorted suit, warped mirror,
cluttered background, text, logo, watermark

Full-body vertical shot with a clean, centered layout. The real subject stands on the right, and the caricature stands on the left at approximately 50–60% of the real subject’s height. Ultra-realistic rendering with natural skin texture and fine detail. Expression is warm, relaxed, and confident.

Gray crewneck sweater (fine knit texture, ribbed cuffs/hem), classic blue jeans (straight fit), and clean white sneakers. Keep textures realistic and clearly visible.

Pixar/Disney-inspired 3D style with exaggerated proportions — large expressive head and smaller body. The height should be noticeably shorter, around the real subject's waist level.

Pose should feel like a living, animated character, not a rigid figurine

Soft, diffused studio lighting from the upper-left, creating smooth highlights and gentle shadows. Clean light-gray gradient seamless background(lighter in the inner areas).

Ultra-clean, cinematic, high-detail render with strong contrast between realistic human and stylized 3D character. Both subjects grounded with soft natural shadows.

prompts.title: The Stages of Life
prompts.prompt:
Create an ultra photorealistic, cinematic 8K portrait (1:1 Square) showing a single male identity evolving across five life stages in a precise diagonal panel composition.
Core Composition & Crucial Alignment:

Divide the image into five clean, parallel diagonal panels (lines slanting upwards from bottom-left to top-right: / / / / /).
Ascending "Staircase" Placement (CRITICAL): The subjects' heads must NOT be on the same horizontal line. They must be vertically staggered in an ascending order. The child in the first panel (far left) must be placed lowest in the frame. Moving left to right, each subsequent older stage must be positioned progressively higher in the frame, ending with the elderly man in the final panel (far right) positioned the highest.
Use sharp, crisp edges (no blur or gradient transitions) for the panel dividers. The layout must feel geometrically precise with consistent spacing and angles.
Use the uploaded image as the ONLY reference. Maintain identical facial structure, proportions, and features across all ages. Only natural ageing changes (skin texture, wrinkles, hair) are allowed. No identity drift.
Life Stages (Left to Right, Lowest to Highest positioning):

Child (6–8): soft smile, pastel t-shirt, short tousled hair, smooth skin (Positioned lowest in the frame)
Teen (14–17): confident, hoodie (muted tones), thicker hair, youthful texture (Positioned slightly higher)
Young Adult (22–28): composed, blazer + plain shirt, well-groomed hair (Positioned in the middle)
Middle Age (38–45): calm, formal shirt, slight hair recession, light wrinkles (Positioned higher)
Elderly (70+): gentle smile, knit/formal wear, grey hair, detailed wrinkles (Positioned highest in the frame)
Environment & Lighting:

Dark charcoal studio background with subtle vignette.
Cinematic lighting: soft frontal key light, strong rim light for separation, minimal fill. Lighting direction must stay consistent across all panels.
Camera & Quality:

Eye-level shot, 85mm lens, shallow depth of field, eyes in sharp focus.
Extreme photorealism with visible pores, natural imperfections, detailed hair strands, and realistic fabric textures.
Post & Constraints:

Cinematic color grading (warm highlights, cool shadows), minimal retouching.
No stylization, no distortion, no identity drift, no background clutter — clean studio only.
